what: five Written-on-the-Wall-II (Graffiti.pc) conjectures, open since 2009/2010, and the explicit counterexamples posted against them on google-deepmind/formal-conjectures on 2026-10-14 (author RhudeJJJJ, self-identified as Jonas J. Gebendorfer, Codex-assisted), decided in exact arithmetic from the archive's definitions

rows.conjecture: WOWII 353 (18 Feb 2009, open): for a tree T on n > 2 vertices, gamma_t(T) >= c(T[D_2]) + (1/2) k_M, D_2 the degree-2 vertices, M the maximum-degree vertices, k_M the order of a largest component of T[M]
rows.claim: the 25-vertex tree of #7304 / PR #7310 (Gebendorfer) is a counterexample: gamma_t = 10 < 21/2

graph.source: fork/WOWII353Proof.lean parent table; the issue: edges 01,12,13,34 plus four pendant gadgets

rows.how: gamma_t by exact tree DP = 10 (the claimant's set of 10 is total dominating; 9 support vertices force >= 9); c(T[D_2]) = 9, k_M = 3, so the right side is 21/2
rows.leanReading: the Lean (PR #7310) states c(T[D_2]) + k_M/2 <= gamma_t over rationals with largestComponentOrder = sup of component orders: the archive's statement

rows.conjecture: WOWII 360 (18 Feb 2009, open): for a tree T on n > 2 vertices, gamma_t(T) >= c(T[S u L]) + (1/2) dist_avg(C, V), L the leaves, S their neighbours, C the centre (minimum eccentricity), dist_avg over the positive distances with denominator |C|(n-1) (definition 38)
rows.claim: the 41-vertex tree of #7305 / PR #7321 is a counterexample: gamma_t = 6 < 4 + 321/160

graph.source: fork/WOWII360Proof.lean parent rule; the issue: path 0..9, leaves 10 at 3 and 11 at 6, 29 leaves at 1

rows.how: gamma_t by exact tree DP = 6 (the set {1,2,3,6,7,8} is total dominating; six vertices with pairwise disjoint open neighbourhoods give >= 6); c(T[S u L]) = 4, centre [4, 5], dist_avg(C,V) = 321/80, right side 961/160; without the half (the 2026 archive copy lost the byte) the right side is 641/80 and the inequality fails too
rows.leanReading: the Lean (PR #7321) ranges centres over minimum eccentricity and averages over |C|(n-1): definition 38; the half is in the 2010 and 2016 archive snapshots (byte 0xBD) and dropped from the 2026 copy

rows.conjecture: WOWII 373 (18 Feb 2009, open): for a tree T on n > 2 vertices, gamma_t(T) >= (2/3) dist_avg(B, V), B the vertices of maximum eccentricity, dist_avg over positive distances with denominator |B|(n-1) (definition 95)
rows.claim: the 150-vertex tree of #7306 / PR #7322 is a counterexample: gamma_t = 12 < 19676/1639

graph.source: fork/WOWII373Proof.lean parent rule; the issue: path v0..v21, 10 leaves at v0, one at v21, 117 at v20

rows.how: gamma_t by exact tree DP = 12 (the 12-vertex set is total dominating); periphery of 11 vertices at eccentricity 23, transmission sum 29514 over 1639 positive pairs, dist_avg = 29514/1639, (2/3) of it = 19676/1639
rows.leanReading: the Lean (PR #7322): periphery = maximum eccentricity, denominator |B|(n-1): definition 95

rows.conjecture: WOWII 396 (Jan 2010, open): for a connected graph on n > 2 vertices, gamma_2(G) <= dd_mode + |M| + |E(A_3, V - A_3)|, M the vertices of the smallest modal degree, A_3 the vertices of degree >= 3, dd_mode the number of distinct modes (definition 45), gamma_2 the 2-domination number (definition 90: members exempt)
rows.claim: the 39-vertex graph of #7308 / PR #7320 (six cliques K4..K9 and five bridges) is a counterexample: gamma_2 = 12 > 10

graph.source: fork/WOWII396Proof.lean block + bridge tables; the issue: K4..K9 with bridges b4,0-b5,0; b5,1-b6,0; b6,1-b9,0; b9,1-b7,0; b9,2-b8,0

rows.how: every clique keeps >= 2 vertices with no outside neighbour, so a 2-dominating set has >= 2 in each of the 6 cliques (12); two per clique 2-dominate (12): gamma_2 = 12. Degree frequencies {3: 3, 4: 4, 5: 6, 6: 8, 7: 8, 8: 7, 9: 3}, modes [6, 7] (dd_mode = 2), |M| = 8, boundary edges 0: right side 10
rows.leanReading: the Lean (PR #7320) writes |M| as maximumFrequency (equal: M is the class of the smallest mode, whose size is the maximum frequency) and dd_mode as the number of modes; definition 45 leaves dd_mode undefined for a unique mode — the witness has two

rows.conjecture: WOWII 395b (Jan 2010, open): for a connected graph on n > 2 vertices, gamma_2(G) <= |M| + delta(G[V - A]) + |V - A_3|, M the vertices of the smallest modal degree, A the minimum-degree vertices, A_3 the vertices of degree >= 3 (the Lean adds the hypothesis that V - A is nonempty)
rows.claim: the 15-vertex graph of #7330 / PR #7337 (K4, K5, K6 and seven bridges) is a counterexample: gamma_2 = 6 > 5

graph.source: fork/WOWII395bProof.lean block + bridge tables (the issue gives no graph; its zip attachment was not opened)

rows.how: gamma_2 = 6 by exhaustion over all 2^15 subsets (a minimum set: [0, 1, 4, 5, 9, 10]); modes [6], |M| = 4, minimum degree 3, delta(G[V - A]) = 1, vertices of degree < 3: 0; right side 5
rows.leanReading: the Lean (PR #7337) adds the hypothesis (remaining G).Nonempty — the archive's delta(G[V - A]) is undefined on regular graphs — which weakens the universal statement; the witness satisfies it (minimum degree 3, twelve vertices above it)
